## Exposure 1: Format Gupta mtDNAcn 
``` {r read_in_gupta}
#Read in Gupta
exposure_path = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/summary_stats/results/Gupta2023mtDNAcn/Gupta2023mtDNAcn.b37.chrall.tsv.gz"
exposure_ss_Gupta <- read_tsv(exposure_path) %>%
  mutate(
    N = 163372,
    Z = ES / SE, 
    P = 10^(-LP)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(CHROM = CHR, BETA = ES) %>%
  mutate(
    TEMP = REF,
    REF = ALT,
    ALT = TEMP) %>%
  select(-TEMP)

#Format (switched alleles)
Format_mtDNAcn_gupta <- exposure_ss_Gupta %>%   
  format_data(.,
              snps = NULL,
              header = TRUE,
              snp_col = "DBSNP_ID",
              beta_col = "BETA",
              se_col = "SE",
              eaf_col = "AF",
              phenotype_col = "TRAIT",
              effect_allele_col = "ALT",
              other_allele_col = "REF",
              pval_col = "P",
              chr_col = "CHROM",
              pos_col = "POS",
              log_pval = FALSE 
   ) %>%
  as_tibble()

Format_mtDNAcn_gupta <- Format_mtDNAcn_gupta %>%
mutate(exposure = "mtDNA_gupta")

mtDNAcn_gupta_gws <- filter(Format_mtDNAcn_gupta, pval.exposure < 5e-8)


#Clump locally
mtDNAcn_clump_gupta <- mtDNAcn_gupta_gws %>% 
  filter(pval.exposure < 1e-5) %>%
  select(rsid = SNP, pval = pval.exposure) %>%
  ieugwasr::ld_clump(
    dat = .,
    clump_kb = 10000,
    clump_r2 = 0.001,
    clump_p = 0.99,
    bfile = '/wynton/group/andrews/data/reference_panels/EUR_All_Chr',
    plink_bin = '/wynton/home/andrews/achatterjee/plink'
  )

#Append the SNPS to combined_mtDNAcn so we can get all the columns
mtDNAcn_gupta_new <- filter(Format_mtDNAcn_gupta, SNP %in% mtDNAcn_clump_gupta$rsid)

#Remove APOE region
mtDNAcn_clump_gupta <- filter(mtDNAcn_gupta_new, !(chr.exposure == 19 & between(pos.exposure, 44912079, 45912079)))
```

## Outcome: Nalls PD
```{r}
outcome_path = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/summary_stats/results/Nalls2019PD/Nalls2019PD.b37.chrall.tsv.gz"

outcome_ss_Nalls <- read_tsv(outcome_path) %>%
  mutate(
    N = 1460059,
    Z = ES / SE, 
    P = 10^(-LP)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(CHROM = CHR, BETA = ES) %>% 
  dplyr::select(DBSNP_ID, CHROM, POS, ALT, REF, AF, BETA, SE, Z, P, N) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(SNP = DBSNP_ID)


# Rename right-side variables to match column names of your GWAS dataset 
outcome_AD_Format_Nalls <- outcome_ss_Nalls %>%
  format_data(.,
    type = "outcome",
    #snps = NULL,
    header = TRUE,
    snp_col = "SNP",
    beta_col = "BETA",
    se_col = "SE",
    eaf_col = "AF",
    effect_allele_col = "ALT",
    other_allele_col = "REF",
    pval_col = "P",
    samplesize_col = "N",
    pos_col = "POS",
    chr_col = "CHROM",
    log_pval = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

outcome_AD_Format_Nalls <- outcome_AD_Format_Nalls %>%
mutate(outcome = "nalls_PD")
```

#LD proxy SNPs
```{r}
# extract gupta SNPs present in outcome
outcome_clump <- semi_join(
 outcome_AD_Format_Nalls, mtDNAcn_clump_gupta, by = "SNP"
)

# Hagg SNPs not present in outcome
exp_snps_wo <- anti_join(
  mtDNAcn_clump_gupta, outcome_AD_Format_Nalls, by = "SNP"
) #59 SNPs

# Use LDLinkR to identify proxy snps
LDproxy_batch(exp_snps_wo$SNP, 
        pop = "CEU", 
        r2d = "r2", 
        token = 'a6deee62cc4a', 
        append = TRUE,
        genome_build = "grch37")
system("mv combined_query_snp_list_grch37.txt exposure_outcome_proxy_snps_gupta_nalls_Aadrita.txt")

# Munge proxy snp file
outcome_dat <- munge_proxies("/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/data/proxy_snps/exposure_outcome_proxy_snps_gupta_nalls_Aadrita.txt", outcome_AD_Format_Nalls, outcome_clump)
```

##Radial MR
```{r}
radial_dat <- harmonised_data %>% filter(mr_keep == T) %>% dat_to_RadialMR()
radial_res <- ivw_radial(radial_dat$mtDNA_gupta.nalls_PD, alpha = 0.05/nrow(radial_dat$mtDNA_gupta.nalls_PD)) #significant outliers
```

##Radial MR (outliers detected)
```{r}
radial_dat <- harmonised_data %>% filter(mr_keep == T) %>% dat_to_RadialMR()
rmr_dat <- radial_dat$mtDNA_gupta.nalls_PD

# Run Radial MR
bonff = 0.05/nrow(rmr_dat) # Bonferonni Correction
radial_ivw_res <- ivw_radial(rmr_dat, alpha = bonff) 

radial_egger_res <- egger_radial(rmr_dat, alpha = bonff) 


#Plot
ivw_radial_p <- plot_radial(radial_ivw_res, radial_scale = F, show_outliers = F)
egger_radial_p <- plot_radial(radial_egger_res, radial_scale = F, show_outliers = F)

## Modify the mrkeep variable to flag variants as outliers from radial MR for removal
mr_dat_outlier <- harmonised_data %>%
  left_join(radial_ivw_res$dat) %>%
  mutate(
     mr_keep = case_when(
       Outliers == "Outlier" ~ FALSE, 
       TRUE ~ mr_keep
     )
  )

## MR analysis 
mr_res_outlier <- mr(mr_dat_outlier, method_list = c("mr_ivw_fe", "mr_egger_regression", "mr_weighted_median", "mr_weighted_mode"))

# Heterogeneity statistics 
mr_het_outlier <- mr_heterogeneity(mr_dat_outlier, method_list = c("mr_egger_regression", "mr_ivw")) 

# Horizontal pleitropy
mr_plt_outlier <- mr_pleiotropy_test(mr_dat_outlier)

# Radial MR 
radial_dat_outlier <- mr_dat_outlier %>% filter(mr_keep == T) %>% dat_to_RadialMR()
radial_res_outlier <- ivw_radial(radial_dat_outlier$mtDNA_gupta.nalls_PD, alpha = 0.05/nrow(radial_dat_outlier$mtDNA_gupta.nalls_PD)) 
```
#Save MR results

write_csv(mr_res_outlier, "/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/results/Aadrita_results/univariate_mr_results/gupta_nalls.csv")
